notes: Metrics only. Raw synthetic captures and machine paths are intentionally local.
First three pairs repeated the exact prompt and shared an OpenCode XDG directory; later prompts include an experiment ID.
The first concurrent pair shared OpenCode storage: one client failed with database is locked before any network request. The isolated pair corrected this.
Wall time includes OpenCode startup, cloud generation and proxy work. PII time is measured separately.
Full-value checks are substring checks, not an exhaustive privacy benchmark. Secret fragments are contiguous eight-character substrings.
Diagnosis check looks for expected port 5432; application port and email are checked separately.

runner_validation.description: Full matrix using the checked-in runner with fresh generated credentials and per-client storage.
